title: HomeFlood Installment Fee for Autopay Customers
content:
**Rule.** The installment fee charged on a HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies installment is set by the policy's recent payment pattern. Every premium payment recorded on the policy in the 12 whole months before the payment date counts.

| Premium payments on the policy in the 12 whole months before the payment date | Installment fee on this installment |
|---|---|
| every one made by ACH, and at least 4 of them | 0 |
| one to three of them, every one made by ACH | 3 USD |
| otherwise (no payment in the window, or any made another way) | the tier's installment fee, 6 USD |

**The payment date.** The payment date is the day the customer makes the payment, and every window and length of time counted to the payment date ends on that day.

**The window.** A payment falls in the window when the whole calendar months from its received date to the payment date are fewer than 12. A count of whole calendar months runs from the earlier date to the later one; the last month is not counted when the later date's day of the month falls before the earlier date's day of the month.

*Hypothetical cases:*
- Five ACH payments in the window: fee 0.
- Two ACH payments in the window: fee 3.
- Three ACH payments and one check: fee 6.
